title: PrecisionPhage: leakage-controlled phage-host prediction and fixed-bank cocktail scoring
description: Scientific code and compact data for leakage-controlled phage-host prediction, frozen source-transfer tests, and retrospective scoring of published fixed-bank Escherichia cocktail assays. The snapshot preserves original frozen predictions and adds explicitly retrospective controls, feature ablations, calibration diagnostics, genome provenance, and crossed host-cluster/composition uncertainty sensitivities. Broad transfer, portable calibrated probabilities, de novo cocktail-selection benefit, and clinical efficacy are not established. Original-source scores remain incomplete for the full 100-host comparison. Manuscripts and private submission or peer-review materials are excluded. Code is MIT licensed; third-party data and software retain their source-specific terms described in SOURCE_NOTICES.md.
